Nippon Express starts PA-AMR operations at Numazu

The rollout starts in part of the warehouse, with staged expansion and continuing map and workflow adjustments.

Rapyuta Robotics / PR TIMES ↗28 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

Operations begin at Numazu

Rapyuta Robotics says its PA-AMR picking assistants have begun operating at Nippon Express’s Numazu Logistics Center in the Shizuoka branch. The project transfers lessons from earlier sites to improve productivity and reduce work burdens at a regional facility.

A staged site rollout

Operations currently cover only part of the target area, with expansion tied to site readiness. Improvements include upper-tray use, supporting tasks, travel maps and parameter adjustments. Site staff hold regular reviews with Rapyuta’s customer-success team.

Results remain unquantified

The deployment supports preparations for a customer’s new products and addresses labor constraints. Robot counts, picking rates and cost savings are undisclosed. Results after expansion will be needed to judge economics or compare the installation with other warehouses.
